title: Egyptian-Style Chicken Tagine
description: A fusion of Egyptian and Chinese flavors, this dish combines aromatic spices with a tender chicken tagine. Serve with steamed rice or noodles.

ingredients.name: aromatic spices
ingredients.notes: Mix of cinnamon, ginger, and allspice

ingredients.name: tagine
ingredients.notes: Moroccan clay pot or substitute with Dutch oven

instructions: 1. Season the chicken breast with salt and black pepper.
2. Heat the oil in the tagine over medium heat.
3. Add the aromatic spices and cook for 1 minute.
4. Add the chicken breast and cook until browned on all sides.
5. Add the egyptian paprika, chicken broth, and cover the tagine.
6. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes.
7. Serve hot with steamed rice or noodles.
